scope: Authored visual reference designs. These proposed product ports and compositions do not claim current managed execution or existing admitted interfaces.

certification.human: An operator needs evidence that the exact live boundary both stops an unmanaged effect and permits declared read-only work.
certification.input: One exact activation, session, workspace and policy identity.
certification.fanout: Send the same identity-bound activation to both required probes.
certification.join: Wait for both probe results, then validate matching identities and ordered time.
certification.outcome: Only matching, successful two-sided evidence would establish the scoped boundary.
certification.gap: Actual same-session probe execution, effect observations and durable testimony remain required.

integratedCircuit.coverage: A three-capability intended review circuit, not a complete estate wiring diagram.

products.meaning: Exact inspection request plus bound authority and pre-effect permit; publication remains pending.
Inspection findings, source identities and output testimony packaged for human review.

integratedCircuit.composition: An interlock resolves an inspection-only request. Its permitted inspection envelope enters candidate inspection. The resulting report enters a review projection that the human can challenge.
integratedCircuit.missing: Admitted interface mappings, live dispatch, exact provider fulfillment, human review evidence and decision-to-effect lineage must close before this becomes an implementation claim.
